perception environment

  • CURIE: gmeow:perceptionEnvironment
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/perceptionEnvironment
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/sensory-environment

The SensoryEnvironment that a SensoryPerception is about — the observedFeature of the claim. Domain is gmeow:Observation so it applies to any observation subclass; the shape narrows to SensoryPerception instances.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Observation -> gmeow:SensoryEnvironment; functional Sub-property of: gmeow:observedFeature

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:perceptionEnvironment from gmeow:Observation to gmeow:SensoryEnvironment when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

gmeow:observedFeature, gmeow:Observation, gmeow:SensoryEnvironment
